title: dryopteris sylvicola
intro: Dryopteris sylvicola, commonly known as forest wood fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a type of fern that is native to North America and is typically found in shaded, moist areas. The health benefits of forest wood fern include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect cells from damage. The bioactive constituents of forest wood fern include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and promoting wound healing.
